items.scope:
Root Scope: Japan organizations.
CNA Scope: Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Vulnerabilities discovered in the services and applications of the MeetMe and DuoxMe products that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities related to TCS-CERT’s customers’ environment and vulnerabilities related to research conducted by Cyber Solutions by Thales’ Intrusion and Application Security Team.
GitHub Enterprise Server issues only.
Jaspersoft products and services only.
All products and services developed and/or sold by Panasonic Group companies.
openHarmony issues only.
All Centreon product issues only.

Vulnerabilities affecting the products, their security-relevant components, and functionality developed and maintained by companies within the EasyVista Group, including:

OTRS - OTRS and features developed and maintained by OTRS GmbH; OTRS container distribution bundle, including container images customized, configured, or maintained by OTRS GmbH; OTRS SaaS and platform components developed and operated by OTRS GmbH; and security-relevant functionality and integrations developed and maintained by OTRS GmbH.

EasyVista - EV Service Manager; EV Service Apps; EV Self Help; EV Observe; EV Digital Experience Monitoring; EV Reach; and EV Discovery.
Zyxel products issues only.
Vulnerabilities in products and services under the Canon brand.
Vulnerabilities in any Google Cloud developed product and not under the scope of another CNA.
Acer issues only.
ABB issues only.

All Trellix Enterprise (formerly McAfee Enterprise and FireEye) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Trellix Advanced Research Center (Trellix ACR) that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.
Vulnerabilities in vendor products discovered by Securifera, or related parties, while performing vulnerability research or security assessments.
All Vaadin products and supported open source projects hosted at https://github.com/vaadin.
All Snow Software products.
Vulnerabilities in AMI firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by AMI that are not covered by another CNA scope.
ASUSTOR issues only.
NVIDIA issues only.
All Netskope products and services.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.

System vulnerabilities regarding the Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch Lite, and vulnerabilities regarding Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch applications for which Nintendo is the publisher worldwide.
All upKeeper Solutions products, excluding end-of-life (EOL) as listed in the upKeeper Solutions End of Life Policy.
Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by ZUSO ART that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Acronis products, including Acronis Cyber Protect, Acronis Cyber Protect Home Office, Acronis DeviceLock DLP, and Acronis Snap Deploy.
Vulnerabilities discovered by YesWeHack community hunters on products being tested on the platform with the permission of their owners, as part of Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure.
All Mattermost issues, and vulnerabilities discovered by Mattermost that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Dell, Dell EMC, and VCE issues only.
Okta issues only.
Vivo issues only.

All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
Current versions of LINE Messenger Application for iOS, Android, Mac, and Windows, plus LINE Open Source projects hosted on https://github.com/line.

Root Scope: Products and technologies of subsidiaries of Thales Group.
CNA Scope: Thales branded products and technologies, products and technologies of subsidiaries of Thales Group, unless covered by the scope of another CNA as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Thales Group and subsidiaries that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerability assignment related to FSI’s vulnerability coordination role in the South Korea financial sector that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All CyberDanube products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party hardware/software discovered by CyberDanube or partners actively engaged in vulnerability research coordination, which are not within the scope of another CNA.
All Payara Platform product distributions (Payara Server, Micro, Embedded) for both Enterprise (commercial) and Community (OSS) distributions.
Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash, X-Pack, and Elastic Cloud Enterprise products only.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.
SolarWinds products only.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by NCSC-FI, and vulnerabilities reported to NCSC-FI for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Products and projects covered by its bug bounty programs that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Everpure (formerly Pure Storage, Inc.) products only.
Zabbix products and Zabbix projects listed on https://git.zabbix.com/ only.
